_comment: The evaluator twin (D3): constructed phrases, and what D1's scorer (app/src/engine/sightReadingScore.ts)
says of each. tools/content/musical_evaluator.py is its Python port, held to these values by
itself to them. `bars` are in the TypeScript helper's notation (helpers/sightReadingPage.ts barOf): a pitch
and a length (w h. h q. q e. e s t), r- a rest, ~ a tie into the next note. `harmony` is the chord under
each bar as a scale degree (0 = I), or `left` the left hand's bars to infer it from. `expected` is written
by the TypeScript spec (STUDY_TWIN_WRITE=1) and never by hand. Major four-bar phrases only prove the port;
the study's multi-phrase and minor semantics have their own unit cases in test_musical_evaluator.py.
